input.headline: Haaland blanks again as low-owned Lewis-Potter and Okafor steal the show

cards.text: The armband let managers down again, and the average of 35 was the lowest of the season so far.

cards.title: Hardly anyone had them
cards.text: Lewis-Potter topped the gameweek with his best score of the season, while Okafor's brace sank Chelsea at home.
The bandwagon arrived just as N.Jackson's run of goals in 3 gameweeks in a row ended in a 0-0 draw.
Wirtz (14 points) and Ngumoha (13 points) each scored and assisted, rewarding the few who owned them.

cards.title: Popular defenders who blanked
cards.text: Two of the most-owned defenders returned a single point each, adding to a painful weekend for template squads.
